theater: 鴨綠水至平壤清川戰線

battle.name: 隋文帝攻高句麗之戰
battle.theater: 鴨綠水至平壤清川戰線
battle.brief: 隋文帝開皇十八年正月下詔伐高句麗，楊廣為行軍元帥，宇文述等分道出師，渡鴨綠水後屯營築圍攻平壤，糧盡掘地而食；十二月在清川遭伏大敗，士卒死者十四五，全軍退回。卡面羅馬方陣盾是共和末期羅馬軍團的盾牆裝備，不在此役現場；役中功能相近者，是隋軍步卒結方陣所執的方盾與長槊。

kit.name: 羅馬方陣盾
kit.history: 凸面的長方盾。羅馬的防線靠盾緣咬住盾緣，不是靠盾牌多厚。

countries: 這場戰爭是隋朝在開皇十八年（598）對東北亞高句麗王國發動的一次大規模出征，由隋文帝楊堅下詔、晉王楊廣掛名行軍元帥，前線由宇文述、于仲文、麥利孝、韓用等行軍總管分道統率。隋軍分三路推進：一路自柳城、熊城、漁陽等遼西諸縣出關；一路出北平、盧龍、渝關；一路由東萊、齊、魯沿海泛海北上，圖從海上直取平壤。兵員多達數十萬，饋運之眾倍之，兵籍來源混雜，既有宿衛十二衛的精兵，也有各郡縣臨時徵發的鄉兵，隸屬關係與指揮體系並不統一。高句麗一方以國王高建武為名，軍事實權分掌於大莫夫一職與各城城主之手，首都平壤的城防由專人經營，北面邊線的精兵則由其弟渾市率領，總數約十五萬；契丹、靺鞨、渤海等周邊勢力同時在北方牽制隋軍，使隋朝無法集中全力於東線。水路那一支由東萊、齊、魯沿海的船戶組成，前後徵發民船數千艘，沿岸人夫亦被拉去搬運。隋軍以行軍元帥府與諸道總管為骨幹，郡縣徵來的鄉兵多不習鼓角，號令難以一致；兩軍都缺乏可供縱深馳援的可靠騎兵，隋軍步卒一旦陷進遼東與鴨綠水之間的山峽，就再也拉不開陣線。
countriesEn: This war was a large Sui dynasty offensive against the Goguryeo kingdom in Northeast Asia, launched in the eighteenth year of the Kaihuang era (598). Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, issued the order and installed his Prince Jin, Yang Guang, as nominal supreme commander, while the front was actually led by line commanders such as Yuwen Shu, Yu Zhongwen, Mai Lixiao and Han Yong. The Sui army advanced in three columns: one through the western Liaoxi commanderies of Liucheng, Xiongcheng and Yuyang; one via Beiping, Lulong and Yuguan; and one by sea from Donglai, Qi and Lu, aiming at Pyongyang from the seaward side. The host numbered in the hundreds of thousands, with an even larger train of supply carriers, and its personnel were a mixture of picked troops from the Twelve Guards of the imperial residence and hastily levied local militia whose chains of command and standards of training were far from uniform. On the Goguryeo side the state was nominally headed by King Gao Jianwu, while military authority was divided between the office of the Grand Mo, the individual city commanders, and the garrisons of the northern frontier, and the defence of the capital Pyongyang was run by its own dedicated command. The picked field army in the north, some 150,000 men, was led by the king's younger brother Hunshi. At the same time neighbouring powers such as the Khitan, the Mohe and Balhae tied down Sui attention in the north, so the court could not concentrate its whole effort on the eastern front. The seaward column was manned by boatmen from Donglai, Qi and Lu, and several thousand civilian craft were impressed for it, with coastal porters conscripted to shift the cargo. The Sui host was built around the headquarters of the supreme commander and the various route commands, while the militia levied from the commanderies had never heard the drum and horn signals and could not be kept in step; neither side had reliable cavalry reserves able to strike deep, and once Sui infantry were drawn into the ravines between Liaodong and the Yalu the line could never be pulled straight again.
people: 隋文帝楊堅是這場戰爭的決策者。他在開皇十七、十八年間因高句麗頻頻擾邊、斷絕朝貢而決心用兵，詔令全國徵發，目標是以一次大規模遠征犁平東北，讓高句麗在失去抵抗能力之後再來稱臣。開皇十八年正月詔下，以其晉王楊廣為行軍元帥，軍令出自中樞，宇文述、于仲文、麥利孝、韓用等分為行軍總管，率諸道將士進討。楊廣本人坐鎮涿郡，未嘗身臨矢石；敗後諸將歸咎於宇文述等宿將不肯用命，隋文帝震怒而終究沒有加罪，楊廣的太子地位反而更加鞏固，同年十月正式被立為太子。高句麗方面，國王高建武在局勢吃緊時派遣弟弟渾市率精兵十五萬迎戰，又遣使請降，藉以換取喘息。於仲文、麥利孝等分道將領在鴨綠水屯營日久，對軍中怨言與糧運不繼的實情最為清楚；宇文述身負全軍總責，回師之後仍受重用，日後再領兵出塞。
peopleEn: Emperor Wen of Sui, Yang Jian, was the man who decided upon this war. After Goguryeo raided the frontier repeatedly and broke off its tribute in the seventeenth and eighteenth years of Kaihuang, he resolved to settle the matter with a single overwhelming expedition, expecting the kingdom to sue for peace only after it had lost the ability to resist. The edict went out in the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang: Yang Guang was named supreme commander, orders issued from the central court, and Yuwen Shu, Yu Zhongwen, Mai Lixiao and Han Yong were appointed line commanders to take the various routes. Yang Guang himself stayed at Zhuojun and never entered the fighting. After the defeat the generals blamed the veteran Yuwen Shu and the others for refusing to execute the orders they had been given, and although the emperor was furious he inflicted no punishment. Yang Guang's position as heir apparent was thereby made even more secure, and in the tenth month of the same year he was formally established as crown prince. On the Goguryeo side, King Gao Jianwu, with the situation going badly, sent his younger brother Hunshi with 150,000 picked troops to meet the Sui army, and later dispatched envoys to sue for peace, buying time by that means. Yu Zhongwen, Mai Lixiao and the other column commanders, who had lain before the Yalu River for weeks, knew better than anyone how exhausted the army was and how the supply lines were failing; Yuwen Shu, who carried overall responsibility for the whole host, was still employed after the retreat and would lead armies beyond the frontier again.
kits: 卡面這件羅馬方陣盾（Scutum）是共和末期至帝國初期羅馬軍團的標準防具：凸面長方，寬約半米，盾緣可以互相咬合成連續的盾牆，後方的重裝步兵就靠這面牆頂住敵方的投射物與衝撞。它並不在開皇十八年的東北亞戰場上；役中與它功能相近的，是隋軍步卒在方陣中執握的方盾與長槊，以及高句麗守軍用於坑道與城堞之間的皮盾、木盾。隋軍的裝備以明光罩甲、槊、刀、弓弩為主，攻城另備雲梯、撞車、穴車與投石機，水師則有蕭艮所督造、上設戰棚與弩楯的大船。糧秣方面倚賴山東與江南輸粟，車、驢、牛與人夫構成綿延千里的運輸線。真正決定勝負的並非甲胄，而是糧食能否按期抵達營中。交戰雙方在野外都靠投石機與火箭對付城牆與人群，真正能持續造成壓力的是弩。隋軍的床弩、臂弩數量不少，與雲梯、撞車配合使用；高句麗則居高臨下，把弩矢傾瀉在攀城的隋軍頭上。營地方面，隋軍以車馬環繞列為營柵，步卒以槊與方盾組成結陣，在營牆缺口處輪流警戒，與羅馬營帳前排盾的做法如出一轍。
kitsEn: The card face is the Roman scutum, the standard defensive equipment of the late Republican and early Imperial legions: a convex rectangle about half a metre wide, whose rims could be braced edge to edge into a continuous shield wall, with the armoured infantry behind it absorbing missiles and charges. It was not on the Northeast Asian battlefield of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang. The closest functional equivalents in this campaign were the rectangular shields and long spears carried by Sui infantry when they formed their square camp, and the hide and wooden shields used by Goguryeo's defenders between the saps and along the ramparts. Sui equipment centred on bright shining armour, spears, sabres, bows and crossbows; for siege work they brought scaling ladders, battering rams, tunnel-carts and stone-throwers, while the navy used the large ships overseen by Xiao Gen, fitted with fighting galleries and shield-armed ballistae. Supplies depended on grain moved from Shandong and the Jiangnan, and carts, donkeys, oxen and porters formed a supply line thousands of li long. What actually decided the outcome was not armour but whether food arrived in camp on time. On the field both sides relied on stone-throwers and fire-arrows against walls and crowds, but it was the crossbow that could keep up sustained pressure. The Sui had no small number of bed crossbows and hand crossbows, used together with scaling ladders and battering rams; Goguryeo shot down from the walls, pouring bolts onto the Sui men climbing the slopes. In camp the Sui ringed their positions with wagons and horses, infantry formed up with spears and rectangular shields, and the gaps in the palisade were watched in turn, a practice not unlike the shielded front rank outside a Roman tent.
tactics: 隋軍的戰術核心是分道並進與多路合擊：宇文述等出柳城、熊城一線，于仲文等出北平、漁陽一線，海路自東萊、齊、魯入海，三路目標同指平壤，欲以兵多勢盛迫其就範。但兵力分散、指揮各異，彼此不能互相照應，加上糧道自後方延伸，結果是先抵前線者先斷糧。渡過鴨綠水後，隋軍在平壤城下屯營築圍，掘壕、堆土山、開地道，試圖以攻城術壓倒守軍；高句麗則以弩、飛石與反坑道在城下列陣反制。隋軍行軍與宿營採結方陣、四面拒敵之法，前鋒與後衛互相策應，進則緩推、駐則環守——這正是羅馬方陣盾牆的基本邏輯，靠整齊的邊線咬合撐住全線，而非靠單兵搏殺。問題在於，方陣能擋住人，擋不住飢餓與嚴寒。清川之戰，高句麗選擇在山峽之間設伏，四面出擊，隋軍在缺糧、缺禦寒、地面積雪泥濘的狀態下陣形崩解，撤退時後衛被追擊掩殺。
tacticsEn: The tactical core of the Sui plan was advance by separate columns with convergence on a single objective. Yuwen Shu took the Liucheng and Xiongcheng line, Yu Zhongwen and the others moved via Beiping and Yuyang, and the fleet sailed from Donglai, Qi and Lu; all three routes aimed at Pyongyang, in the hope that sheer numbers would compel surrender. But the forces were dispersed, each under separate command, unable to support one another, and each dependent on a supply line stretched from the rear, so those who reached the front first were the first to starve. After crossing the Yalu the Sui army encamped around Pyongyang, dug trenches, piled up earth ramps and drove saps in an attempt to take the city by siegecraft; Goguryeo answered with crossbows, stone-throwers and counter-saps dug out to meet them from below. On the march and in camp the Sui formed square arrays that faced outward on all four sides, the vanguard and the rearguard covering each other, advancing slowly in formation and holding in a ring when halted - precisely the logic of the Roman scutum wall, where a continuous line of locked rims carried the whole front rather than individual soldiers fighting it out. The problem was that such a formation could keep men at bay, but could not keep back hunger and cold. At the fight by Qingchuan, Goguryeo chose to lie in ambush among the ravines and strike from several sides; the Sui army, short of food, without winter clothing, and sinking in snow and mud, came apart, and the rearguard was destroyed in the pursuit.
data: 兵員數字各書不一，是本役最難核實的一環。《隋書》記隋軍出動甲士百十三萬五千餘人、饋運者倍之，《資治通鑑》則記五十餘萬，兩說相差一倍以上；即使採最保守的一說，實際能列陣作戰的兵力也遠低於帳面數字，而被徵發的鄉兵多缺乏甲胄與訓練。編制上，隋軍分道而行，統帥宇文述、于仲文、麥利孝、韓用等各領一路，兵員由數萬至十數萬不等。高句麗方面，渾市所部精兵約十五萬。行程上，鴨綠水至平壤約二百餘公里，渡江後屯營四十餘日，糧秣耗盡，士卒掘地穴取食；出師至全軍退回歷時約一年，正月下詔、十二月敗還。損失方面，《資治通鑑》記全軍士卒死者十四五，即死亡人數接近出戰兵力之半；返程之際糧秣衣物耗盡，士卒多掘坑掩埋同伴屍體而去。至於雙方的實際傷亡總數，史料多只給出比例而非名冊；可以確定的是，隋軍退回遼東與幽州時已不成軍編，許多部隊的旗籍與名簿在敗亡中散失，而高句麗的城邑與人口在整場戰役中基本沒有遭到進攻與佔領。
dataEn: Figures for the armies differ from book to book, and this is the hardest part of the campaign to verify. The Book of Sui records 1,135,000 or more armoured men, with twice as many again in the supply train, while the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance gives more than 500,000 - a difference of more than double between the two. Even taking the most conservative figure, the number actually able to fight in line was far below the paper strength, and much of the levied militia lacked both armour and training. In organisation the Sui host moved in separate columns, each led by a commander such as Yuwen Shu, Yu Zhongwen, Mai Lixiao or Han Yong, and ranging from several thousand to more than a hundred thousand men. On the Goguryeo side the picked army under Hunshi numbered about 150,000. As for distances, Pyongyang lies roughly 200 kilometres beyond the Yalu; after crossing the river the Sui camped there for more than forty days until provisions ran out and the men dug holes in the ground for food. The whole operation, from the edict of the first month to the retreat in the twelfth, lasted about a year. In losses, the Comprehensive Mirror records that soldiers numbered among the dead reached 140,000 or 150,000 - that is, close to half of those who had fought. On the way back, with food and clothing exhausted, the men were said to dig pits and bury their dead comrades where they fell. As for actual casualty totals, the sources give ratios far more often than rosters; what can be said with certainty is that the Sui army was no longer organised in units when it fell back into Liaodong and Youzhou, the muster rolls of many formations lost in the rout, while the towns and population of Goguryeo were for the most part never attacked or occupied during the whole campaign.
cause: 開皇十七年（597）起，高句麗與隋朝的邊界摩擦日增：高句麗屢次出兵劫掠隋朝邊縣，奪人畜、陷城堡，斷絕朝貢，其間又有隋朝邊民與俘虜逃入高句麗而為內應之嫌。隋文帝先以遣使責問、令其謝罪處置之，繼而在開皇十七年冬命幽州方面出塞討伐，雖有斬獲而未能竟功。高句麗一方則利用隋朝在西北正與西突厥交兵、兵力被牽制的空檔，繼續加固北方城防，並與靺鞨、渤海往來。隋廷之中，主張一舉犁平東北的聲音一直存在，但反對者指出山東、江南的糧食運到幽州、遼東要耗去十數年月的民力。開皇十八年正月，文帝終於下詔，以高句麗與契丹犯邊為名，發兵百餘萬大舉東征，局勢就此不可收拾。
causeEn: From the seventeenth year of Kaihuang (597) the friction along the Sui-Goguryeo border grew steadily. Goguryeo repeatedly raided Sui border counties, seizing livestock, overrunning forts and cutting off tribute, and there were persistent suspicions that Sui defectors and captives had taken refuge there and served as guides. Emperor Wen first reproached the kingdom through envoys and demanded atonement, then in the winter of the seventeenth year sent troops from Youzhou across the border; they won some prizes but did not finish the job. Goguryeo meanwhile exploited the fact that the Sui was engaged with the Western Turks in the northwest and had troops tied down, and went on strengthening its northern defences while maintaining ties with the Mohe and Balhae. Within the Sui court there was always a voice calling for a single sweep of the northeast, but others pointed out that moving grain from Shandong and the Jiangnan to Youzhou and Liaodong consumed the labour of the people for a dozen years or more. In the first month of the eighteenth year of Kaihuang the emperor finally issued the edict, giving the campaign the name of Goguryeo and Khitan border violations, and mobilized more than a million men on paper. From that point the situation could no longer be brought back under control.
impact: 這次敗仗對隋朝的代價遠超過戰場本身。出征消耗的糧秣、衣物、牲畜與民力，須由山東、江淮的租調與徭役填補，開皇末年原本繁盛的戶口與充盈的府庫被大量耗散；鄉間青壯被抽調之後耕織失據，邊州屯田也因戰事而廢。這套以傾國之眾押上單一戰役的用兵邏輯，後來在大業年間三征高句麗時原封不動地重演：同樣是糧道不繼、同樣是寒冬、同樣是水陸兩路互相不能策應，最終把隋朝推向崩潰。政治上，這場戰役反而鞏固了楊廣的地位：他是掛名的行軍元帥，兵敗的責任落在宇文述等宿將身上，而他本人遠在涿郡、沒有直接捲入戰場，同年十月正式被立為太子，日後平定楊諒之亂時更佔盡上風。對東北亞而言，高句麗不僅安然度過危機，還得以加固城防、修練兵甲，坐看渤海與靺鞨坐大，成為唐初東北國際秩序的重要一極。
impactEn: The cost of this defeat to the Sui went far beyond the battlefield itself. The grain, clothing, animals and labour consumed by the expedition had to be replaced from the taxes and corvee of Shandong and the Jianghuai, and the populous, well-stocked state of the late Kaihuang years was drained; with the young men of the villages taken away, farming and weaving fell away, and the frontier garrisons' fields were abandoned to the war. The logic of committing a whole nation's host to a single battle would be repeated unchanged in the three campaigns against Goguryeo in the Daye era: the same broken supply lines, the same winter, the same failure of the land and sea routes to support each other, and by the end the Sui dynasty was pushed towards collapse. Politically the campaign instead strengthened Yang Guang. He was the nominal supreme commander, but the blame for the defeat fell on the veteran Yuwen Shu, while Yang Guang himself remained at Zhuojun and never entered the fighting; in the tenth month of the same year he was formally established as crown prince, and later he had the upper hand when Yang Liang's revolt was put down. As for Northeast Asia, Goguryeo not only survived the crisis but used it to harden its walls and drill its troops while the Mohe and Balhae grew in strength; Goguryeo would go on to be one of the pillars of the international order in Northeast Asia at the beginning of the Tang.
result: 結局是隋軍全軍退回，高句麗完勝。正月下詔、二月出師，至十二月隋軍在清川一線崩潰，宇文述等引還，沿途遭追擊掩殺，《資治通鑑》記士卒死者十四五，這場遠征以最慘烈的方式收場。高句麗國王高建武趁勢遣使請降，隋文帝接受稱臣的說法，罷兵回師，沒有追加報復，雙方恢復了表面上的朝貢關係。從軍事結果看，隋朝完全沒有達成戰役目標：平壤未下，鴨綠水未守，北方邊境照樣受威脅；但從高句麗一方看，這是一場乾淨利落的勝利：城防經受了考驗，兵甲得到了鍛鍊，國力幾乎未損，國際地位反而因為擊退隋朝而穩固。隋朝此後轉向懷柔與經略，等待下一次機會——那要等到二十多年後的隋煬帝，才會重開這條戰線。
resultEn: The outcome was a complete Sui retreat and a clean Goguryeo victory. From the edict of the first month and the departure of the columns in the second, through to the collapse of the Sui army in the region of Qingchuan in the twelfth month, Yuwen Shu and the others withdrew under pursuit, and the Comprehensive Mirror in Aid of Governance records that soldiers numbered among the dead reached 140,000 or 150,000; the expedition ended in the most ruinous way possible. King Gao Jianwu took advantage of the moment to send envoys to sue for peace; Emperor Wen accepted the fiction of Goguryeo's submission, withdrew the army and did not pursue revenge, and the two sides resumed their nominal tributary relations. Judged militarily, the Sui achieved nothing: Pyongyang was not taken, the Yalu was not held, and the northern frontier remained as threatened as before. Judged from the Goguryeo side, however, this was an unambiguous victory: the defences had stood the test, the troops were seasoned, the country's strength was scarcely touched, and its standing in the region rose because it had turned back the Sui. The Sui then turned to conciliation and preparation, waiting for the next opportunity - which would not come until more than twenty years later, when Emperor Yang of Sui reopened this front.
